bounded_question: What are the StatisticsImpl vtable slots 0x98/0xa0/0xa8 (0x6070490, 0x6070610, 0x6070700) — the third direct caller of the ticker getter 0x6070430 was the slot-0x98 routine, left unmapped by #3378 — what do they compute end to end, how do they share the mutex and the histogram builder, and how are they reached?

0x606b6f0.note: HistogramImpl text renderer (#3371); the single call is from its entry thunk 0x606bc90.

0x606bce0.note: HistogramImpl percentile struct (#3371); reached by tail jump from its thunk 0x606bdd0.

0x606fba0.note: Slot-0xb0 record routine: no direct call or tail jump; reached only through the vtable (RELATIVE 0x64d2e38).

0x6070430.note: Ticker shard-sum getter: exactly three direct callers — the locked read 0x6070490, ToString 0x6070810, and the slot-0xf0 fill 0x6076030.

0x607047e.note: Landing pad of the locked ticker read: the pad at 0x60704c6 jumps here on exception.

0x6070490.note: Locked ticker read (slot 0x98): no direct call, tail jump or lea anywhere in the binary; reached only through the vtable (RELATIVE 0x64d2e20).

0x6070500.note: Histogram builder: exactly three direct callers — the locked percentiles 0x6070610, the locked histogram text 0x6070700, and ToString 0x6070810.

0x60705d8.note: Cleanup fragment for slot 0xa0 (delete temp + unlock + resume). The second 0xa0 landing pad jumps to its interior entry 0x60705e7 (unlock only); that interior jump is visible in locked_percentiles.txt, not in callers.tsv.

0x6070610.note: Locked percentiles (slot 0xa0): no direct call, tail jump or lea; reached only through the vtable (RELATIVE 0x64d2e28).

0x60706ca.note: Cleanup fragment for slot 0xa8 (delete temp + unlock + resume). The second 0xa8 landing pad jumps to its interior entry 0x60706d9 (unlock only); that interior jump is visible in locked_histogram_text.txt, not in callers.tsv.

0x6070700.note: Locked histogram text (slot 0xa8): no direct call, tail jump or lea; reached only through the vtable (RELATIVE 0x64d2e30).

0x6070810.note: StatisticsImpl::ToString (#3362): no direct call; reached only through the vtable (RELATIVE 0x64d2e70).

0x6076030.note: Slot-0xf0 ticker-map fill (#3378): no direct call; reached only through the vtable (RELATIVE 0x64d2e78).

0x60d5230.note: Mutex lock wrapper; the three locked reads call it at 0x60704a4, 0x607063e and 0x607072e.

0x60d52f0.note: Mutex unlock wrapper; the locked reads and their cleanups call it at 0x6070481 (landing pad), 0x60704b9, 0x60705ea (cleanup 0xa0), 0x6070684, 0x60706dc (cleanup 0xa8) and 0x6070774.

cleanup_a0_0x60705d8.contract: Exception cleanup for the locked percentiles 0x6070610 (its own FDE): delete the temp HistogramImpl through its vtable slot 0x8 when (%rsp) is non-null, unlock the mutex in r13, check the stack canary, resume unwinding. Two entries: the head 0x60705d8 (delete + unlock, reached from the 0xa0 landing pad at 0x60706b8) and the interior 0x60705e7 (unlock only, reached from the 0xa0 landing pad at 0x60706c4).

cleanup_a8_0x60706ca.contract: Exception cleanup for the locked histogram text 0x6070700 (its own FDE): the mirror of cleanup_a0 — delete the temp through its vtable slot 0x8 when (%rsp) is non-null, unlock the mutex in r13, check the stack canary, resume unwinding. Two entries: the head 0x60706ca (delete + unlock, reached from the 0xa8 landing pad at 0x60707b0) and the interior 0x60706d9 (unlock only, reached from the 0xa8 landing pad at 0x60707bc).

0x98.note: Indirect calls through vtable displacement 0x98 (call *0x98(%r..)) across the whole binary. Displacement-wide, not type-attributed: any class with a slot at 0x98 contributes, so this is an upper bound on StatisticsImpl dispatches, not an exact caller count. Full site list in dispatch.tsv.

0xa0.note: Indirect calls through vtable displacement 0xa0 across the whole binary; same displacement-wide caveat as slot 0x98.

0xa8.note: Indirect calls through vtable displacement 0xa8 across the whole binary; same displacement-wide caveat as slot 0x98.

following_vtables.note: Vtables that follow the StatisticsImpl primary vtable in the group. Their typeinfo slots sit at primary +0x108/+0x138/+0x170; they are not StatisticsImpl slots and their functions are not mapped here — only their identities (typeinfo name + first function slot) are recorded.

histogram_builder_0x6070500.contract: Build a fresh 0x3c8-byte HistogramImpl for histogram id (rdi=out, rsi=stats, edx=id): allocate via _Znwm, install the HistogramImpl vptr, initialise the inner struct (0x606b080 bucket-count init, 0x606b0c0 locked init, mutex zeroed), publish *out, then merge each of the 2**shard_bits shards' records at shard_base + shard*0xce40 + 0x598 + id*0x3c8 via the merge wrapper 0x606bdf0. Its own landing pads (0x60705c0, 0x60705cc) jump to the fragment at 0x60704d2..0x60704fd, which deletes the 0x3c8 object and resumes — that fragment is not part of this packet (it belongs to the builder's own exception path, not to the locked reads).

histogram_snapshot.note: The temp built by 0x6070500 is a HistogramImpl whose percentile struct (vtable slot 0x78, 0x606bce0 via thunk 0x606bdd0) and text renderer (vtable slot 0x30, 0x606b6f0 via entry 0x606bc90) are pinned in #3371; only their contracts are restated here, not their bodies.

lines: one row per non-empty bucket with a '#' bar of one '#' per 5 percent

histogram_snapshot.shard_layout: counters at shard + id*8; histogram records at shard + 0x598 + id*0x3c8; 0x598 + 53*0x3c8 == 0xce00, leaving a 0x40 tail per shard whose contents are an open unknown

landing_pad_0x607047e.contract: Exception cleanup for the locked ticker read 0x6070490 (its own FDE): unlock the mutex in r12 (this+0x38) via 0x60d52f0, then _Unwind_Resume with the exception in rbx. No temp exists on this path — the getter builds none.

strings.0x963298: basic_string: construction from null is not valid

locked_histogram_text_0x6070700.arg_order: (rdi = sret out string, rsi = stats, edx = histogram id) -> rdi. The stats object arrives in rsi, not rdi: the routine returns a std::string by value, so rdi is the hidden return-value pointer and rsi is `this`. The caller allocates the out string; the routine returns the same pointer.
locked_histogram_text_0x6070700.mutex: rsi+0x38 (the stats object's mutex, not rdi's)
locked_histogram_text_0x6070700.signature: (out: string*, stats: StatisticsImpl*, hist_id: u32) -> string*
steps: Lock the mutex at rsi+0x38 via 0x60d5230 (call site 0x607072e).
Build a fresh HistogramImpl temp via 0x6070500(rsp, rsi, edx) (call site 0x607073c).
Render into the out string through the temp's vtable slot 0x30 (call *0x30(%rax) at 0x607074b; entry 0x606bc90, renderer 0x606b6f0).
Destroy the temp: compare its vtable slot 0x8 against GOT 0x64ed2f0 (sized delete 0x5d8b3b0); equal -> _ZdlPvm(temp, 0x3c8) at 0x607076c, else call the deleting dtor at 0x60707a0.
Unlock via 0x60d52f0 (call site 0x6070774), check the stack canary, return rdi (the out string).
Exception path: landing pads at 0x60707a9 (jmp 0x60706ca: delete temp + unlock + resume) and 0x60707b5 (jmp 0x60706d9: unlock only).

locked_percentiles_0x6070610.signature: (this: StatisticsImpl*, hist_id: u32, out: HistogramData*) -> void
steps: Lock the mutex at this+0x38 via 0x60d5230 (call site 0x607063e).
Build a fresh HistogramImpl temp via 0x6070500(rsp, this, edx) (call site 0x607064c).
Fill the caller's struct through the temp's vtable slot 0x78 (call *0x78(%rax) at 0x607065b; thunk 0x606bdd0, percentile struct 0x606bce0).
Destroy the temp: compare its vtable slot 0x8 against GOT 0x64ed2f0 (sized delete 0x5d8b3b0); equal -> _ZdlPvm(temp, 0x3c8) at 0x607067c, else call the deleting dtor at 0x60706a8.
Unlock via 0x60d52f0 (call site 0x6070684), check the stack canary, return.
Exception path: landing pads at 0x60706b1 (jmp 0x60705d8: delete temp + unlock + resume) and 0x60706bd (jmp 0x60705e7: unlock only).
Lock the mutex at this+0x38 via 0x60d5230 (call site 0x60704a4).
Sum the ticker over its shards via 0x6070430(this, id) (call site 0x60704ae).
Unlock via 0x60d52f0 (call site 0x60704b9) and return the sum.
Exception path: the landing pad at 0x60704c6 jumps to 0x607047e (unlock + _Unwind_Resume); the getter itself makes no calls, so in practice the pad covers the lock call.

mutex_lock_0x60d5230.contract: pthread_mutex_lock wrapper (re-shipped from #3362/#3378); return codes 0 and 0x6e are accepted, any other prints 'pthread %s: %s' and aborts. It never throws a C++ exception, so the accessors' landing pads cover the builder/delegate calls, not the lock.

mutex_unlock_0x60d52f0.contract: pthread_mutex_unlock wrapper (re-shipped from #3362/#3378); same accept/abort discipline as the lock wrapper, never throws.

re_shipped_from.note: ticker_getter/mutex_lock/mutex_unlock copied byte-identical from RE-001-stats-ticker-map-115 (#3378); histogram_builder copied byte-identical from RE-001-stats-produce-115 (#3362). verify.py regenerates every excerpt fresh from the binary and requires byte-equality, which subsumes the re-ship check.

statistics_impl_vtable.note: Primary vtable, 32 slots (+0x0..+0xf8), re-derived from the RELATIVE records in relocations.txt. The records at primary +0x108/+0x138/+0x170 are the typeinfo slots of the following group vtables (see following_vtables), not StatisticsImpl slots.

slots.0xb0: 0x606fba0 (record/tick: byte at this+0x20, index <= 0xb1, lock add into the shard)

ticker_getter_0x6070430.contract: sum over 2**(u8 at this+0x68) shards of the u64 at *(this+0x60) + shard*0xce40 + ticker*8 (ticker is zero-extended from u32)

unknowns: The public C++ names of the three routines are not established from the stripped binary; they are described by observed behaviour, signatures and vtable slots, not by source-level names. (The arg shapes match the documented RocksDB Statistics interface — a u64 ticker count, a HistogramData fill, and a by-value string return — but that match is inference, not a binary-established name.)

Which landing pad covers which call site inside 0x6070610/0x6070700 is inferred from the temp's lifetime (the builder-call pad must be the unlock-only one, since no temp exists yet; the delegate-call pad must be the delete+unlock one), not read from the LSDA; the two fragments' shapes and their jump targets are pinned.
The 0x40 tail at the end of each 0xce40-byte shard (0xce00..0xce40, after the last histogram record) is not examined; its contents are open.
Slot 0xb0 (0x606fba0) is the record/tick write path, not a read; its hash/index helper 0x60d5cd0 and the exact ticker-id bound (0xb1 vs the 179 counter slots) are not mapped here.
The remaining StatisticsImpl vtable slots (0x10..0x90, 0xb8..0xe0 except 0xe8/0xf0) are not mapped; only their RELATIVE-backed addresses are recorded.
